title: Father's ship crew sees an object leave the water
place_text: at sea; jungles and ocean (father from Honduras)

plain: A whole ship's crew of 29 or 30 men is said to have watched something come up out of the sea, rise into the sky and shoot away. A guest named Mario Woods tells Michels this as a story his father, a man from Honduras, often told him. Woods says his father saw many strange things in the jungles and on the ocean, and if the story is true, a whole crew saw an object move from water to sky.
